planets.name: TIC 198190129 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TIC 198190129 with a 7.95-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TIC 198190129 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TIC 198190129. Its orbit and size follow Lafarga et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
